67891.commentary: (VINa) vituḍentī'ti vinivijjhitvā gacchanti. vitudentī'ti vā pāṭho, asidhār'ūpamehi tikhiṇehi lohatuṇḍehi vijjhantī'ti attho.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena kosambiyaṃ bhikkhū bhaṇḍanajātā kalahajātā vivād'āpannā aññam'aññaṃ mukhasattīhi vitudantā viharanti.

67896.grammar: prp of pass of vi √tud, pass, intrans (+instr)

67898.commentary: (VINa) vituḍentī'ti vinivijjhitvā gacchanti. vitudentī'ti vā pāṭho, asidhār'ūpamehi tikhiṇehi lohatuṇḍehi vijjhantī'ti attho.

examples.text: idh'āhaṃ, āvuso, gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto addasaṃ aṭṭhikasaṅkhalikaṃ vehāsaṃ gacchantiṃ. tam'enaṃ gijjhā'pi kākā'pi kulalā'pi anupatitvā anupatitvā phāsuḷ'antarikāhi vitudenti vitacchenti virājenti. sā sudaṃ aṭṭassaraṃ karoti.
evaṃ su te kuttavālehi vaḷavārathehi dīghāhi patodalaṭṭhīhi vāhane vitudentā vipariyāyanti, seyyathā'pi tvaṃ eta'r'ahi sācariyako'ti? no h'idaṃ, bho gotama.
